notes.title: MX vs ATV All Out - 2.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog
v2.8.0

Bug Fixes

Prevent drone cam from going under ground
Removed duplicate brakes part on Honda TRX 450 ATV
Tuning sliders appear in correct position when returning to the Tuning menu after setting the value to a maximum
AI Riders appear in all events in a playlist in Online Multiplayer.
Other minor fixes and fixes for rare issues


Improvements

Added "Custom Camera" controls to Drone Cam. (Drone Camera uses slightly different behavior when custom camera is enabled. To use the classic drone cam disable "custom camera" in the Gameplay Settings menu.)
Drone Cam available Online in Spectator mode.
Added Camera Shake behavior; option in Gameplay Settings, disabled by default
Added controller preset - Button Shift 2 Alt - where Shift Up and Shift Down buttons are flipped
Adjusted all gear and vehicle textures to appear better in dynamic lighting
Minor tuning to outdoor lighting
Minor AI improvements
Improved visual quality of trees and other foliage
Minor performance improvements outdoors

notes.title: MX vs ATV All Out Update 2.6.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog
v2.6.0

Graphics & Performance Updates

Framerate stability improved on all platforms
Major reductions to "hitching" during gameplay
Improved lighting in all Indoor environments
Improved terrain textures in outdoor environments
Improved terrain deformation game-wide


Feature Updates

Updated Flying Moto Ranch environment
 - *NEW TRACK* - Added Golden Eagle SX
 - *NEW TRACK* - Added Rolling Hills National
 - New Time of Day variations


Gameplay Updates

Re-tuned physics on all tuneable parts
 - Tuneable parts have a greater impact on physics
 - Added Chassis tunable part (affects handling/sensitivity)
 - Removed Clutch as an explicitly tuneable part
Re-tuned lower gear ratios for smoother, more reliable shifting when accelerating
Decreased tire traction when tuned to the maximum amount
Decreased turning friction when leaning forward
Various improvements to AI game-wide


General Updates & Misc. Improvements

Updated all outdoor environments
 - New Time of Day variations
 - Various updates and improvements to all outdoor tracks
Online Match settings saved for duration of the session
Updated Engine sounds on 250 2-stroke
Additional engine sound and volume improvements
Added option to toggle Controller Vibration On/Off in Gameplay Settings
Additional controller presets with button shifting
Increased Jersey name character limit from 9 to 11
Increase chance for BRAAP riders to appear in events
Added "Close” camera
Added "Drone” camera
Added AI Rider Blake Wharton
Added AI Rider Dylan Stark
Added AI Rider Jayden Vecchio


Bug Fixes

Fixed rider falling through the vehicle after a reset
Fixed bug causing online client's split time HUD to disappear after lap 3.
Fixed issue in which incorrect times were being posted to leaderboards during online multiplayer
Various other bug fixes for online multiplayer
Other misc. bug fixes not listed here

notes.title: MX vs ATV All Out Update 2.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog
v2.3.0

Physics

 Fixed exploit that allowed engine to accelerate to 100+ mph
 Fixed bug where transmission would not downshift after a reset


AI

Overhauled AI to be more competitive on ALL TIME difficulty
Re-balanced all difficulty levels
Added Pierce Brown and Taylor Heiman AI riders
Assign more MX125 riders to ALL TIME difficulty to fill a full gate
Fixed issue causing some AI riders to be disabled


Leaderboards

All leaderboards have been reset
Implemented GLOBAL leaderboards
Implemented TOP 100 leaderboards
Player is now highlighted in list


Tracks and Environments

Enabled lighting variants for GOAT FARM DLC
Added reset function in certain areas to prevent track cutting
Enabled pan/tilt/zoom controls on spectator cams
Fixed bug where players were reset on the wrong side of the finish line


General

Minor audio changes/fixes
Performance improvements
